claim_boundary: This receipt covers source, regression tests, and one real SAbDab2 train-role forward/backward stress example. It contains no optimizer step, validation-based model selection, frozen-test access, external-test access, generalization result, or model-quality improvement claim.

motivation.observed_alignment_gap: Training used one pairwise wrong partner per direction while development evaluation ranks the cognate among 31 candidates per direction and selects on the worse direction.
motivation.implemented_candidate: Deterministic K-negative listwise contrastive specificity loss with optional normalized smooth-maximum aggregation over the two retrieval directions.
motivation.temperature_choice: T=1.0 makes K=1 listwise exactly equal to the legacy pairwise softplus, including gradients; the initial T=0.1 memory stress is not the frozen training configuration.
motivation.negative_count_8_status: engineering stress comparator only; do not train or select it unless a validation-only protocol explicitly promotes it

regression.skip_boundary: Five optional Boltz Pairformer adapter tests were skipped because the pinned Boltz source was unavailable in the test environment; no FrameContact, listwise objective, checkpoint/dropout-RNG, split, frozen-test gate, or evidence-lock test was skipped.

initial_no_checkpoint_run.diagnosis: Saved-tensor CPU offload retained activations for every wrong partner.

activation_checkpoint_rerun.checkpoint_scope: wrong-partner branches only; cognate branch and default K1 path unchanged

gpu_stress.performance_boundary: Single-example stress timings are not a throughput benchmark and must not be generalized to full training, A100, or another sequence-length distribution.

next_gate: Wait for the pre-existing five-condition by five-seed development matrix to finish and freeze its validation-only base-model selection.
